M3a (referral accept flow) — live Supabase, 27 Aug 2026, BEFORE apply

BASELINE
  referral_accept exists   : no
  counsellors              : Karabo, Nicola
  counsellor_clients rows  : 0
  counselling_referrals    : 0
  counselling_notes        : 0
  bookings financial/psych : 22 / 0
  bookings policies        : 11

THE PREDICTION — written before applying

  CHANGES
    ONE function appears: referral_accept(uuid), granted to authenticated.

  DOES NOT CHANGE
    No table, no column, no policy, no row, no grant on anything else.
    All seven baseline figures above are unchanged.

  UNTIL SOMEBODY CALLS IT, NOTHING ABOUT THIS MIGRATION IS OBSERVABLE. There
  are zero referrals on live, so there is nothing for it to act on today. It is
  being applied now so the capability exists when Karabo and Nicola need it,
  not because anything is waiting.

  IF IT IS WRONG
    The realistic failure is a referral that cannot be accepted — visible and
    harmless. The dangerous failure would be acceptance granting BACKWARD
    access to the referring counsellor's notes or bookings, which assertions
    44-46 of tests/m3-tests.sql exist to catch and which passed locally.

  EXPECTED AFTER-STATE, EXACTLY
    referral_accept exists   : yes
    everything else          : identical to the baseline above
